summary: Lot 3 admin.py → routes/admin/ package split: ZERO regression confirmed. Authored 35 HTTP/integration tests covering all 11 admin domain modules (auth, vehicle_types, driver_categories, merchants, users/stats/wallet, settings/CRUD/service-config/db-backup, rewards, analytics, monitoring, onboarding) including write ops (POST/PUT/DELETE round-trips for vehicle-types and driver-categories, PUT settings/wallet-reserve-config/rewards-config no-op round-trips). Cross-module re-exports verified: in-process `from routes.admin import get_rewards_config, _clean_driver_category, DEFAULT_REWARDS_CONFIG` all resolve, helper executes cleanly, and the driver-facing rewards path lazily importing get_rewards_config does NOT 500 with Import/Name/AttributeError. Pre-existing 27 helper unit tests (test_clean_driver_category.py + test_rewards_dispatch_helpers.py) still pass. No NameError/AttributeError/ImportError observed on any of the 27 unique endpoints + parametrized variants hit (35 total test cases). All admin endpoints returned expected 2xx status codes.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin/_common.py is 710 lines — already at the soft threshold. If more helpers/constants are added during future work, consider extracting domain-specific helpers (e.g., the rewards _merge_rewards_settings / _rewards_zone_* helpers ~lines 580–700) into routes/admin/_rewards_helpers.py to keep _common.py focused on truly shared primitives.

routes/admin/__init__.py side-effect imports the 11 domain modules to register routes — fine, but order matters for module-level @router decorators; the explicit `__all__` listing only `router`, `get_rewards_config`, `DEFAULT_REWARDS_CONFIG` while other helpers (e.g. `_clean_driver_category`) are re-exported via `from ... import` may confuse static analyzers. Either add all re-exports to __all__ or drop unused re-exports.

PUT /admin/vehicle-types/{slug} validates against VT_FIELDS but does not accept the legacy `name`/`label` aliases; not a regression (same behavior as pre-split) but worth confirming with frontend callers.
seed_data_creation: Test creates and immediately deletes one vehicle-type (slug=test_vt_<rand>) and one driver-category (id=test_dc_<rand>) per run; nothing persists. PUT round-trips for settings/wallet-reserve-config/rewards-config write back the GET response (no-op).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Lot 3 refactor of routes/admin.py → routes/admin/ package is fully verified. The regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_split_regression.py is reusable. Run from /app with `pytest backend/tests/test_admin_split_regression.py -v`. For pre-existing helper unit tests (which use `from routes.admin import ...` at module top), run from /app/backend with `pytest tests/test_clean_driver_category.py tests/test_rewards_dispatch_helpers.py -v`.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The package split (routes/admin.py → routes/admin/ with _common.py + 11 domain modules) preserves all 65 endpoints and re-exports all helpers consumers depend on (get_rewards_config consumed by routes/drivers.py and routes/rides.py). Behavior is identical to pre-split.
